question: Is the promised result of the year-long monthly practice declared as certain truth?
premises: The result of the prescribed practice is stated to occur.
There is explicitly no doubt in this matter.
The speaker affirms having spoken the truth to the brahmins.
inference: Therefore, the result of the year-long monthly practice is presented as an unquestionable truth.
uncertainties: The exact subject of gacchati is carried over from the prior context.
plain_english: It goes; in this there is no doubt. O brahmins, I have spoken the truth.
